about_the_game:
Returning music & sound design duo, Fat Bard, blast the sonic palette of the Crashlands universe into deep space with an epic, cinematic, and otherworldly take on the original soundtrack. This 90+ minute genre clash of ambient soundscapes and country-western americana features every track from the game, including cutscenes and radio tunes.

Swelling synths accompany plucking reverberated melodies, melancholic blues-y guitar swings in and out of focus, driving percussion shifts between dark pulses and alien tribal drum circles, familiar motifs cling to story-driven cues, and quirky EDM adds a dash of whimsy.

The 39 songs have been fully re-mastered for this release, uniquely sequenced for the optimal listening experience, and are delivered in 320kbps MP3 and FLAC format.
